mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at overcast skies with a temperature of 92 degrees feeling like 99 near the Military Ridge State Trail, and please note the air quality index is currently 58.

The City Clerk's office is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students. Submissions are open until July 22, and the community will vote on the final designs from July 28 through August 7 to feature in our November election.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, plus yoga sessions at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In a report from the Verona Police Department, on July 13, an officer arrested a 36-year-old man for O-W-I after he was found with his vehicle stuck on a large rock.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for the OREO Cookie Overload flavor of the day. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
